inspiration: Tile sheets as numbered indexes with a few families (terrain, objects, large landmarks such as stadium and seaport). The sheet index is the data. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/SimHacker-micropolis/micropolis-activity/images (tiles-N and obj families)

One fixed render rig for a whole building kit: orthographic camera at one angle, a hemisphere fill and a sun light, a set output size and a stated scale, so every building reads from one angle. Matches the client-only camera and light rule. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/SimHacker-micropolis/micropolis-graphics/buildings_3d/standards.txt lines 1-25

Buildings split into separate render parts (body, roof, turf, sign, shed, east and west faces) so a sign or roof can change without a new model. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/SimHacker-micropolis/micropolis-graphics/buildings_3d/com01/roof.png and sign.png; res06/east_bldg.png

Footprint size classes (1x1, 3x3, 4x4) with a 16 and a 32 pixel variant, shown in the render script names. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/SimHacker-micropolis/micropolis-graphics/buildings_3d/scripts/3x3_32x32.map

A text crop map from source boxes to atlas cells, so a render pass becomes a tile atlas by script. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/SimHacker-micropolis/micropolis-graphics/buildings_3d/scripts/3x3_32x32.map line 1 onward

Short named cues for build and demolish actions, plus a disaster cue set (monster roar, explosion near and far, siren). Names only, content not listened to. Refs: /mnt/frankendom-donors/SimHacker-micropolis/MicropolisCore/res/sounds/build.wav and bulldozer.wav; micropolis-java/resources/sounds/monster.wav

Advisor messages keyed by need, one line per key (residential need, commercial need), a readable warning table with translations. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/SimHacker-micropolis/micropolis-java/strings/CityMessages.properties line 9 onward

briefs.label: Quay compound
briefs.why: a waterside building with a 3x3 footprint reads as a different zone at a glance
briefs.keep: a 3x3 footprint; waterside siting; a crane-like silhouette
briefs.change: a stone quay with a painted gate instead of a plain yard; a lantern line on the quay edge; a different roof form. Recreate as a clearly distinct original

briefs.label: Arena ring
briefs.why: a round bowl is a readable landmark silhouette at 375 wide
briefs.keep: a large round landmark; a single entrance
briefs.change: a ring of banners and a torch row instead of stands; a different roof profile. Recreate as a distinct original

briefs.label: Hill giant roar
briefs.why: one signature roar plus an explosion pair makes a disaster readable by ear
briefs.keep: one roar cue; two explosion levels for near and far
briefs.change: a deep chant instead of a roar; a ground rumble in place of the siren; a different pitch. Recreate as a distinct original

briefs.label: Raise and clear sounds
briefs.why: the build and the clear actions each have a named cue, so the player hears the change
briefs.keep: one cue per build action; one per clear action
briefs.change: our own foley: a pitch lift on build and a dust hiss on clear. Recreate as a distinct original

briefs.label: Locked-camera item set
briefs.why: one camera and one light rig makes every item in a set look like one artist made it
briefs.keep: a fixed camera angle; a set output size; a two-light rig
briefs.change: our fight camera's three-quarter angle; a rim light from the fight camera; a different output size. Recreate as a distinct original
